The structure of LaNiAs₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmmm (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms (La₄Ni₄As₈) across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows As centers with 9 geometric neighbors, including La, Ni, and As, while La and Ni each have 11 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between 9-vertex As polyhedra, with corner- and edge-sharing also observed between As and 11-vertex La or Ni polyhedra.
